items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I interviewed with Halsey Stevens, cause I wanted to study composition with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well he needed to be sorry. [Laughs] Well, this is... I wanted to ask you about Halsey Stevens.
Yeah, and I know that he had wrote the book on Bartok and America.

ctx.x: Oh I know you are, I know you are.

But my point is that the school didn’t understand, and Halsey Steven does, and he was also big in Ukrainian songs and stuff like that, and the Russian stuff. But he told me that Bartok was using his folk themes even before I knew - But I mean, Booker and I had heard something in there.
